title: Not speaking readings
body: On all versions after 2018.11.15 my Motorola G4 set up as a follower will not speak any readings after the 1st one when you start speak readings.  Any suggestions or help with this.

comments.body: I've tested with 2018.11.29 and 2018.12.01 versions using follower mode and speak readings is working on a Samsung Galaxy A3 running Android 8.0

Tried it again after seeing you message  updated to 2018.12.01 Still does not work for me . It reads the initial  reading when entering the check mark but then no further readings All versions that I have tried up to and including 2018.11.15 work fine any thing after that does not work. My phone is Motorola G4+ Android 7.0 I guess I will just stay with 2018.11.15 Thanks
Thank you for your testing. I have looked through all the commits between 15th Nov and 25th Nov and there is only one thing I think it could be. I will revert that for the next nightly.

It is working correctly  now on 3rd DEC  version  Thank you so much.
Again Thank you for all you do and this GREAT APP
My Wife would be lost without Xdrip-plus I  can only HOPE you will make it work with 14 day US sensors PLEASE

Do you get any event log messages on the follower like: `Received a bg reading that appears to be in the future:` ?

Regarding the US 14 day Libre sensors, I think there would need to be a working group that gets some really good data sets to make any progress.

I just went and looked  every reading has an error message in the event log. Most of the errors appear to be about 10 seconds. Do you need the logs?

I wish I could offer some help on the 14 day sensor I am much more a hardware guy than a coding person. So for now we are buying as many 10 day sensors as i can find.

Thanks again for all you do.
